passage:
metric — 指标；衡量标准
However, a group of teachers and two local researchers have now challenged this common metric.

breadth — 广度；广泛程度
The participation rate, they concluded, was measuring breadth but not depth.

depth — 深度；深刻程度
The participation rate, they concluded, was measuring breadth but not depth.

dashboard — 仪表盘；数据汇总面板
He proposed a “depth and breadth” dashboard that would report three separate figures: the percentage of students who attend at least one session, the percentage who attend ten or more sessions, and the average number of sessions per attendee.

appendix — 附录
He suggested that the board keep the participation rate as a headline figure and publish the other numbers in an appendix.

headline — 标题；头条数字
He suggested that the board keep the participation rate as a headline figure and publish the other numbers in an appendix.

consistent — 一致的；始终如一的
The difference was not huge, but it was consistent.

compromise — 妥协；折中方案
The board has not yet made a final decision, but a compromise is emerging.
